The '''Hearth House''' was, along with the [[Field House]], one of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kinyen/Legends|Kinyen's]] two legislative bodies. The Hearth House's members served for life, and were selected by the Field House from a group of candidates. Each candidate had more extensive training for [[Politics/Legends|political]] life than the Field House's candidates. The majority of Kinyen's laws were created in the Hearth House; after their creation, the laws were sent to the Field House, which could veto any law passed by the Hearth House. The latter met in a section of [[Doellin's Ring]], the center of Kinyen's planetary government, which was also known as the [[Hearth House (location)|Hearth House]].<ref name="Strongholds" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Hearth House was mentioned in the [[2015]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' expansion ''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]'', which was published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
